language.name: English
startup.title: Mumbler could not start
startup.body: Mumbler could not finish opening its saved state or window.
startup.detail: Your recordings and saved files were not changed. Restart Mumbler to try again, or close it and inspect the session log.
diagnostic.storageTitle: Storage Location Could Not Be Resolved
diagnostic.storageBody: Mumbler could not use its configured storage folder. Restore access to that folder or remove the MUMBLER_HOME override, then reopen the app.
diagnostic.corruptTitle: Saved Data Could Not Be Loaded
diagnostic.corruptBody: Mumbler could not safely load its saved data. The files were left unchanged; check the log before reopening the app.
diagnostic.startupBody: Mumbler could not finish preparing its storage. Reopen the app to try again; saved files were left unchanged.
diagnostic.resetBody: Mumbler could not reset its saved state. Existing files were left unchanged; check the log and try again.
diagnostic.windowBody: The window encountered an unexpected problem. Restart Mumbler to continue; your saved files are unchanged.
diagnostic.mainBody: Mumbler encountered an unexpected problem. Restart the app to continue; your saved files are unchanged.
